meta.name: hyperframes-registry
meta.description: Install, discover, and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions. Use when running hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, installing one item or every block matching a tag, wiring an installed item into index.html, or working with hyperframes.json. Covers discovery, install locations, block sub-composition wiring, component snippet merging, and authoring a new block or component to contribute upstream (idea → scaffold → validate → PR).

copy.tagline: 安装、发现和编排 HyperFrames 组件块
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在用 HyperFrames 构建组合式前端应用
copy.tagline_en: Install, discover, and wire HyperFrames registry blocks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build composable frontend apps with HyperFrames

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 能帮你安装 HyperFrames 的注册表块和组件、浏览可用目录、把安装好的块或组件接入项目页面，还能指导你编写新块或组件并提交上游 PR。
howto.when: 当你说出 hyperframes add 或 hyperframes catalog 等命令，或要求安装、接线、处理 hyperframes.json 时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 hyperframes add 安装 data-chart 块。
say.note: 它会安装块并提示你接线属性。

say.text: 列出 catalog 中带 social 标签的块。
say.note: 它会显示匹配的块列表。

say.text: 把刚装的 grain-overlay 组件接到我的 index.html 里。
say.note: 它会指导你复制片段并合并。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude can help you install HyperFrames registry blocks and components, browse the catalog, wire installed items into your project, and guide you through authoring new items for upstream PRs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say commands like 'hyperframes add' or 'hyperframes catalog', or ask to install, wire, or work with hyperframes.json.

say_en.text: Install the data-chart block with hyperframes add.
say_en.note: It installs the block and shows the wiring snippet.

say_en.text: List blocks tagged 'social' in the catalog.
Wire the grain-overlay component into index.html.
say_en.note: It guides you through merging the snippet.
